observation_law: theta~declared uniform; U independent pricing randomness; Y=C_hat_512_262144(theta,U)+0.25*epsilon, epsilon~N(0,I9). Finite numerical model, not continuum exact prices.

reference.method: prior importance sampling over independent (theta,U) rows
reference.likelihood: Gaussian quote noise centered on clean reference_prices; do not add pricing_covariance
reference.fallback: No automatic bank expansion; report unresolved cases and stop acceptance. Two compatibility rows in validation/test are unused.

target_pricing.estimand: Posterior mean of the 512-step expected discounted payoff, with independent target randomness V. No target-price quantile or continuum accuracy claim.

training.selection: minimum loss on unaugmented validation IDs 0:256
training.normalization: training data only; no per-panel scaling

final_test.access_rule: Only after all reference and neural validation gates pass; no tuning on final outcomes. Final-test evaluation is a separate explicit run.

stop_rule: One architecture, seed and 80-epoch budget. Freeze before bank generation. Failed reference gates prohibit an accepted conditional inference claim; failed neural gates keep final test reserved. No sweep, no automatic scaling, no market acquisition dependency.
